songYml.title: song.yml Structure
songYml.fieldAuthor: author (required): Song author or band name
songYml.fieldTags: tags (optional): List of tags for categorization
songYml.filesDesc: Source files associated with the song (paths relative to song directory).
songYml.fieldLilypond: lilypond: List of LilyPond notation files (.ly)
songYml.fieldTex: tex: List of LaTeX source files (.tex)
songYml.fieldDate: date: Date the song was added or last modified
songYml.fieldDigest: digest: MD5 digest for change detection
songYml.structureDesc: Ordered list of sections that make up the song. Each item has an id (unique) and an item with a YAML tag.
songYml.tagChords: !Chords: Chord section with title, type (intro/couplet/refrain/pont/outro), color, rows (chords separated by |, x2 for repeats), and optional drum_sequence.
songYml.tagRef: !Ref: References another section's chords via link field. Inherits color and type from the linked section.
songYml.colorsDesc: Optional. X11 color names: Wheat1, Coral1, DarkSeaGreen1, Aquamarine2, white, etc. If not provided, colors are taken from the rendering settings based on section type.
songYml.chordFormatDesc: Chords separated by |. Add x2, x3 at the end to repeat. Special: HRest (half rest).

macros.title: TeX Macros
macros.songword: Regular lyric word. Renders text as-is.
macros.songwordfb: First beat word. Red background box to mark the first beat of a bar.
macros.songwordl: Pickup/levee word. Blue italic text in brackets [text] for notes before the first beat.
macros.songwordcount: Beat count. Tiny red subscript number to indicate beat position.
macros.songbookcomment: Comment. Inline text displayed as-is (e.g. performance notes).
macros.songly: Include LilyPond output. Imports the compiled notation from a .ly file.
macros.basecouplet: Section block. Colored header box with title, followed by content. Color is a LaTeX color name (e.g. green!20, blue!10).
